blocks.text: The series adaptation of “Crazy Rich Asians” is looking for new faces to join its expanding cast, as a global casting call is now underway for two Asian characters. Firefly Casting took to Instagram on Tuesday, Nov. 3, to announce that it is accepting audition submissions for the roles of Posy and William, with interested applicants from around the world invited to submit self-taped auditions. According to the casting breakdown, Posy is a woman in her 30s of East Asian descent, a former socialite whose marriage to a notorious tycoon has fallen apart, who remains unapologetic about her pursuit of wealth […]...
